## How I checked it

- [ ] `poetry run pytest tests/unit` passes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm test` passes (if the UI changed)
- [ ] `poetry run ruff check . && poetry run ruff format --check .` is clean

- [ ] No keys, tokens, personal data or generated files are included
